zombie-rush.title: Zombie Rush - Roguelike Action Game
zombie-rush.description: Zombie Rush is a thrilling Roguelike action game where you can play as unique heroes battling through waves of zombies. Use gems earned from defeating zombies to enhance your abilities. Equip automatic weapons, dodge attacks, and lead the fight! As you progress, you'll grow stronger, discover new perks, and upgrade your special skills. The more you play, the more challenging it becomes with increasingly dangerous zombies. Test your skills and courage in Zombie Rush today!
